project: Name for project. If you want to upload additional data to an existing project, use the exact same project name
experiment/subproject:
How you want your samples organised. 
Each unique starting-strain, set of media, and/or set of environmental conditions should be a separate experiment. Not too long.
experiment details:
Put the paper DOI here
doi:actual-doi

For unpublished experiments, you can you can put anything here
sample type:
"clonal" or "population"

Should auto-fill. Drag down the bottom right corner down for newly added rows
filename: Must contain "R1" and have the following extensions: .fq, .fq.gz, .fastq, .fastq.gz
filename2: Must contain "R2" and have the following extensions: .fq, .fq.gz, .fastq, .fastq.gz
additional read files:
Please enter additional read files here
Comma-separated, must contain "R#"
indexfile: Must contain "I1" and have the following extensions: .fq, .fq.gz, .fastq, .fastq.gz
indexfile2: Must contain "I2" and have the following extensions: .fq, .fq.gz, .fastq, .fastq.gz
additional index files:
Please enter additional index files here
Comma-separated, must contain "I#"
starting strain:
The strain this sample is evolved from
Be specific enough that another researcher could find the strain to reproduce the experiment
reference file name(s):
Exactly as file is saved on machine. Names should be descriptive and unique to the genome version
comma-separated, ideally .gb or .gbk files
reference file url(s): If not available on ncbi or any other easily accessible online source, please upload the file to the reference_sequences repository on the SBRG Github. If multiple files, make sure the order matches that in the previous field.
medium derived from:
Base growth media
Don't include things like carbon source/supplements here

carbon source and modifications go in another column.

See the 'Media' tab for details on these Medias
medium modifications:
Line separated separated key-value pairs.
Input "N/A" if not applicable.

example change types:antibiotics, sulfur source, electron acceptor, nitrogen source, etc
format:
change type:compound1(concentration),compound2()
change type2:compound3(concentration)
change type3:compound4(concentration)
carbon source:
Carbon source added to media.
source(concentration)
Input "N/A" if not applicable.
g/L unless otherwise specified
medium description: Please describe anything the medium modifications couldn't capture in text here.
environmental condition modifications:
comma-separated in the following format: modification-type:changed-parameter(additional amount if applicable)
Currently defaults to 
temp:37
aerobic:true

Input "N/A" if not applicable.
taxonomy id:
taxonomy of the strain used
can be found through ncbi
accession:
If unavailable, use the closest accession you can find for this strain.
i.e. if engineered, use accession of the strain it was engineered from.
owner: Your aledb username case sensitive. For external projects, use "ale"
owner email: email of person responsible for the project. For external projects, use "aletechdev@gmail.com"
cultivation details: Additional details on the cultivation process
sequencing library prep kit manufacturer:
Which company made this kit.
If the company is not in the drop-down, 
feel free to type in your own.
